# Editable cover-letter template

Original template. Replace every bracketed item, remove instructions and verify claims before use. Follow the posting's length and submission rules.

[Your name and contact details you choose to include]
[Date]
[Recipient or hiring team]
[Employer name]

Dear [recipient / Hiring Team],

I am applying for the [exact role title] role at [exact employer]. My experience [one specific, supported connection to an important requirement] is relevant to your request for [posting requirement].

In [actual work / volunteer / project setting], I [action, task and scope from your evidence notes]. [Explain its relevance without claiming a result you cannot support.]

[Second relevant example, grounded in a different note. If needed, acknowledge a relevant skill gap accurately; do not invent experience or automatically claim willingness to learn.]

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss [specific role connection]. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

## Before using this

- Compare every claim with your evidence worksheet, not just the job posting.
- Confirm the exact role, employer, recipient and current contact details.
- Remove brackets and instructions; check the employer's word limit and required format.
- If using Reactive Resume, paste only the body paragraphs. Set recipient and sender details in its separate fields; greeting/sign-off are added by the editor.
- Do not submit this template with fictional/example facts.
